meta.title: Used motorcycle in Finland: inspection, modifications, licence classes, who pays and storage
meta.method: Checked on 2026-10-17 against Finlex (consolidated laws and Traficom's regulation), Traficom, Liikennevakuutuskeskus, EUR-Lex and If's published motorcycle terms. Every fact the page shows has a source id below. Anything that could not be confirmed was left out: there is no published average price for a modification or registration inspection, and the rules don't single out engine tuning.
meta.conventions: Strings in 'rule', 'note' and 'who' are shown on the page as they are. 'source' is one id or a list of ids from 'sources'. 'where' is the section in the source.
meta.corrections: Valtioneuvoston asetus 1455/2019 was repealed by Ajoneuvolaki 82/2021 (in force 15.1.2021, with parts from 1.3.2021); inspection duties are now in the Vehicles Act itself.

inspection.rule: Motorcycles have no periodic inspection in Finland.
inspection.otherInspections: A registration inspection before a bike is first registered in Finland, or before it goes back on the register after an insurer had it removed as damaged; a modification inspection; an inspection ordered by the police; roadside checks.
inspection.where: Ajoneuvolaki 82/2021 148 § (the list of classes with periodic inspection has no L3e), 133–134 §, 143 §, 165 §, 200 §
inspection.quoteFi: M-, N-, O2-, O3-, O4-, L6e- ja L7e-luokan ajoneuvo sekä luvanvaraisessa tavaraliikenteessä käytettävä T1b- … on esitettävä määräaikaiskatsastukseen

loweredSuspension.rule: Lowering a motorcycle doesn’t need a modification inspection, as long as the wheels still turn freely in every position. If’s kasko terms don’t cover lowering springs or other aftermarket chassis parts.
loweredSuspension.where: Traficom regulation 4.1, 5.2 and 8.2; If AUT 640.35, 2.1 kohta 5
loweredSuspension.quoteFi: Moottoripyörää ja mopoa ei tarvitse esittää muutoskatsastukseen, jos rungon korkeutta suhteessa pyörien keskiöön suurennetaan enintään 60 mm tai pienennetään.

aftermarketExhaust.rule: An approved silencer made for this bike needs no inspection. Any other silencer, or a modified one, needs a modification inspection with noise and emission evidence.
aftermarketExhaust.quoteFi: ajoneuvoon vaihdetaan siihen tarkoitettu alkuperäistä osaa korvaava EY-, EU- tai E-hyväksytty varaosakatalysaattori tai -äänenvaimennin

riskIncrease.rule: When the policy terms ask for it, changes that raise the risk must be told to the insurer; if not, a kasko payout can be cut or refused.
riskIncrease.trafficInsurance: For traffic insurance the consequence is a higher premium charged afterwards, for the current year and up to five years back, not a smaller payout (LVL 15 §).
riskIncrease.quoteFi: Jos vakuutuksenottaja tahallisesti tai huolimattomuudesta, jota ei voida pitää vähäisenä, laiminlyö 2 momentissa säädetyn velvollisuutensa, korvausta voidaan alentaa tai se evätä.

licences.where: Ajokorttilaki 386/2011 4 § 1 mom 1–4 kohta, 5 § 1 mom 1–4 kohta, 7 § 3 mom

AM.covers: mopeds with a design speed over 25 and up to 45 km/h, and light quadricycles

licences.includes: A includes A2 and A1; A2 includes A1.
licences.quoteFi: A2, johon kuuluvat moottoripyörät, joiden enimmäisteho on 35 kW, teho/painosuhde enintään 0,2 kW/kg ja joita ei ole muunnettu ajoneuvosta, jonka teho on yli kaksi kertaa niin suuri

moped.rule: A moped (L1e-B) has a design speed of at most 45 km/h, at most 50 cm³ with a combustion engine and at most 4 kW. A two-wheeler above those limits is a motorcycle (L3e).

others.note: Damage to another vehicle is paid when your side was to blame.

ownInjuries.note: Not if you rode drunk or high, and it can be cut for gross negligence. Not in races or track practice.
ownInjuries.quoteFi: liikennevakuutuksesta korvataan … myös vahingon aiheuttaneen ajoneuvon kuljettajan henkilövahinko

gear.who: Your own traffic insurance doesn’t pay
gear.note: If another vehicle was to blame, its traffic insurance pays. If’s kasko covers the helmet and helmet phone, not the riding suit.

ownDamage.who: Covered only with full kasko · after your excess
ownDamage.note: At If, collision cover comes with full kasko, with a €200 or €500 excess. If another vehicle was to blame, its traffic insurance pays.
ownDamage.where: LVL 40 § 1 mom; If AUT 640.35, 3.1; If guide p. 6–7

theft.who: Covered with kasko · after your excess
theft.note: At If, only if the bike was locked, with a €200 excess. Traffic insurance never covers theft.
theft.where: If guide p. 3 and 8; If AUT 640.35, 3.2–3.2.1

wear.rule: Wear and other slowly developing damage isn’t covered.

outOfUse.rule: A bike can be taken out of traffic use for the winter. At If, its theft, fire and vandalism cover stays on while it’s stored.
outOfUse.ridingWhileOut: Riding it while it’s out of traffic use can cost up to three times the traffic insurance premium.
outOfUse.where: If's page on liikennekäytöstäpoisto; Traficom; LVL 8 § and 22 §

vehicleTax.note: Motorcycles pay no annual vehicle tax · Vehicle Tax Act 1281/2003, 4 §
vehicleTax.quoteFi: Ajoneuvoveroa on suoritettava rekisteriin merkityistä luokkiin M ja N kuuluvista ajoneuvoista.

abs.where: Regulation (EU) 168/2013, Annex VIII and Annex IV 2.3.3

effect.text: A European study found that ABS cut injury crashes by 24–34% and severe or fatal ones by 34–42%.

newOwner.rule: Traffic insurance is the new owner’s duty from the day of the sale: the seller’s covers only the first seven days.
